baseline.name: Resort stones before every smash
baseline.approach: Sort the remaining stones each round to find the two largest.
baseline.time: O(n^2 log n) conservative worst-case bound over shrinking rounds

archived.name: Reusable max-heap
archived.time: O(n log n), with O(n) heap build
archived.space: O(log n) recursive heapify stack; input-backed heap

why: The heap repairs only paths affected by two removals and an optional insertion instead of fully sorting again.
quantitative_comparison: There are at most n-1 smash rounds; each archive round performs two pops and at most one push with logarithmic repair, rather than one whole-array sort. No elapsed-time multiplier is established.
tradeoffs: Input order/content is changed, heap helpers assume valid sizes, and heap overhead may not help tiny stone sets. No claim over every alternative priority queue is made.
evidence_basis: Static heap-operation comparison to repeated sorting; no benchmark.
